thread:
Hannah: Quick thought 1: Bridge Night + Cheese Board + tiny chess corner this Thursday 6:30pm in the library alcove? low-key, BYOB optional, bring a slicer or a favorite cheese if you want. :cheese_wedge:
Diego: love that combo. i can bring a couple of semi-soft cheeses and a cutting board. any dietary flags?
Ruth: i'll bring crackers (gluten-free option included) and some fruit. can we do an applause-judged 'best pairing' mini game?
Owen: count me in for chess demo corner 1: i can teach a 10-min blitz primer for beginners at 7pm.
event-bot: Quick poll: React with :one: to play bridge, :two: to play chess, :three: to snack/watch. Poll ends in 48h.
Hannah: sign-up sheet: https://tiny.rw/bridge-cheese (add what you bring and if you want to demo a pairing).
Diego: small note: some cheeses have truffle oil (contains dairy) - i'll label.
Ruth: i'll print tiny allergen tags and a 'pairing suggestion' card template.
Owen: equipment: i have two folding chess sets and a timer. volunteers to help set up tables at 6:10?
Hannah: volunteers: @Diego for table setup, @Ruth for labels, @Owen for chess setup. i'll bring napkins and a small vase of flowers.
Diego: i can also bring a corkscrew and a non-alc sparkling option.
Ruth: prize idea: a novelty cheese knife + a silly ribbon for the pairing winner?
Owen: tiny logistics: library alcove seats ~24 comfortably. RSVP so we don't overflow. tiny.rw/bridge-cheese has headcount.
event-bot: Reminder set for Wednesday 12:00: "Bridge/Cheese/Chess RSVP cutoff"
Hannah: two small rules: please keep voices low (library), and no open flames.
Diego: question: bridge experience level? should we do a quick rules primer?
Ruth: maybe do one bridge table for experienced players and one 'learners' table. we can rotate after a round.
Owen: absolutely. i can run chess blitz at 7 and then a casual play-after.
Hannah: if anyone needs plates/utensils, please note in the sheet. trying to reduce disposables so BYO is appreciated.
Diego: plan to bring a small trash/compost station and labels.
Ruth: small accessibility note: the alcove has one step, i'll mark that in the sheet for anyone who needs ground-floor seating.
Owen: volunteers for teardown at 8:45? i can handle stacking chess sets.
Hannah: thanks everyone 14 i'll post the final layout Wednesday evening and assign a 'host' at the door to welcome folks. :sparkles:
event-bot: Event created: "Bridge Night + Cheese Board + Chess Corner" 14 Volunteers updated.
